selected_bottleneck: apply-persisted-postimage-file-budget-integrity（应用持久化后像单文件预算完整性）
selected_problem: Fresh canonical main enforced MAX_FILE_BYTES=2,000,000 on each write while staging, but apply only checked persisted postimage bytes/size/hash self-consistency. A coherently enlarged after image above the approved single-file limit therefore remained internally consistent and was written successfully after durable reload.
decision_basis: CHANGE_FILE_TOO_LARGE and MAX_FILE_BYTES are existing stage-time resource constraints, so revalidating the same limit at apply preserves the current protocol rather than choosing a new budget.
The defect is directly falsifiable by coherently replacing after.contentBase64/size/sha256 with 2,000,001 bytes while leaving all other staged metadata valid.
Hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained temporarily unavailable with HTTP 502; this cycle used DWAC_SOURCE_CONTRACT_REPLAY（DWAC 源码契约重放） and exact local focused validation.

pre_fix_reality.focused_reproduction: EXPECTED_FAILURE: 1/2 PASS, 1/2 FAIL with Missing expected exception; apply accepted and wrote a 2,000,001-byte persisted postimage.
pre_fix_reality.impact: Durable STAGED reload could bypass a side-effect resource bound that stage had explicitly approved.

change: Apply now rejects a verified write postimage whose actual decoded byte length exceeds MAX_FILE_BYTES before ancestor checks or workspace side effects.

validation.node_check: PASS on the exact proposed core/changesets.mjs content
validation.focused_tests: 12/12 PASS, 0 skipped across the accumulated apply-integrity regressions

truth_boundary: This preserves the existing single-write byte budget across durable reload. It does not yet revalidate the aggregate MAX_TOTAL_BYTES changeset budget and is not an authenticated artifact mechanism.
